title: Concrete input and internal scalar-total path
statement: For ScalarSectionData c and internal complexes P,Q, scalarTensorSectionInput is the composite of c.derived, the derived section tensor comparison and the two section localization isomorphisms. scalarTensorSectionPath is the section image of D.map of the internal localization tensorator, compute on P tensor Q, and totalScalar, followed by the localized total section comparison and the two termwise c.ordinary comparisons. These are actual morphism constructions with the endpoints of the two normalization paths.
